title: Repair averages and targeted costs
scenario: Tervalon Pipe Services is examining 28 fictitious repair records. The team wants typical repair time for selected cells and shifts, plus cost attributed to one defect family. A training-only prioritization rule combines a group average with total Seam-repair cost.

lesson.intro: A conditional mean uses only matching observations. Its denominator is the number of matching numeric values, rather than every row in the table. Clean data still requires careful choice of group.

functions.name: AVERAGEIFS
functions.purpose: Average numeric values whose rows meet every criterion.
functions.arguments: average_range holds measurements; aligned criteria range/value pairs define the eligible rows.
functions.result: 26 when D2:D4 contains 18,26,34 and B2:B4 contains Day,Night,Day
functions.useCase: Mean repair duration for a cell and shift.
functions.mistake: No matching numeric observations produces #DIV/0!, not a meaningful zero.

functions.name: SUMIF
functions.arguments: range is screened; criteria is the condition; optional sum_range supplies values instead of range itself.
functions.result: 200 when B2:B4 contains Seam,Edge,Seam and D2:D4 contains 90,60,110
functions.useCase: Attribute costs to one defect family.
functions.mistake: SUMIF puts the criterion range first; SUMIFS puts the sum range first.

lesson.combine: Reuse IFERROR to label missing groups, ROUND to present a mean, and IF with AND for a two-part decision. Multiple conditions belong in AVERAGEIFS; a single cost-category condition can use SUMIF. Do not confuse an average duration with a summed duration.

tasks.prompt: Calculate unrounded mean Repair_min for Cell Mill-2, across all shifts and defect families.
Calculate mean Repair_cost_CAD for Cell Mill-2, Shift Night and Defect_family Seam, rounded to two decimals. Use No repairs if the group has no numeric observations.
Total Repair_cost_CAD for Defect_family Seam, across both cells and shifts.
Return Prioritize if mean Repair_min for Mill-2 Night records exceeds 40 AND total Repair_cost_CAD for all Seam records exceeds 1500. Otherwise return Monitor. These are separate groups, as stated.

bonus.prompt: Calculate the percentage of total repair cost attributed to Seam records, rounded to two decimals. Submit a percentage number, not a fraction.

columns.name: Defect_family
columns.description: Training defect category: Seam, Edge or Surface.
